source.sqlReaderQuery: select MAX(LastModifyTime) AS NewWatermarkvalue from data_source_table

sqlReaderQuery.value: select * from data_source_table where LastModifyTime > '@{activity('OldWatermarkTable').output.firstRow.WaterMarkValue}' and CAST(LastModifyTime <= '@{activity('NewWaterMarkTable').output.firstRow}' AS DATETIME)
